page.overview:
Who is Eradan?

Eradan was the second Ruling Steward of Gondor.

Eradan was born in TA 1999 and was the son of Mardil Voronwë. Following the death of his father in TA 2080, Eradan became the second Ruling Steward, and the second Steward to rule during the era known as the Watchful Peace. Eradan, served as Ruling Steward until his death in TA 2116 at the age of 117 after a rule of thirty-six years. He was succeeded by his son Herion.

Eradan was the first Steward to use a Sindarin name.

Eradan is a Sindarin word. -adan is the singular form of "edain".
